'''''Cyperus michelianus''''' is a species of [[Cyperus|sedge]] that is native to parts of [[Europe]], [[Asia]], [[Africa]] and [[Australia]].<ref name=kew>{{cite web|url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:1054019-2|title=''Cyperus michelianus'' (L.) Delile|access-date=21 April 2022|publisher=Kew Science – Plants of the World Online}}</ref> It grows in wet habitats such as river margins and [[paddy field]]s.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Cyperus michelianus in Flora of China @ efloras.org |url=http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=2&taxon_id=200026698 |access-date=2022-07-22 |website=www.efloras.org}}</ref>
